summary: MPIN (4-digit PIN) authentication feature fully tested and working. All backend APIs pass (24/24 tests). Frontend MPIN login mode and Security Settings setup flow both working correctly.

context_for_next_testing_agent: MPIN feature is fully functional. Backend uses bcrypt for MPIN hashing. MPIN login creates cookie-based session same as password login. The MPIN router is at /api/mpin/* with endpoints: set, status, verify, login, remove.

backend_mpin_apis.POST /api/mpin/set (authenticated): PASSED - Sets 4-digit MPIN with bcrypt hash
backend_mpin_apis.POST /api/mpin/verify (authenticated): PASSED - Verifies MPIN for sensitive actions
backend_mpin_apis.POST /api/mpin/login (no auth): PASSED - Login with email + MPIN, returns session
backend_mpin_apis.DELETE /api/mpin/remove (authenticated): PASSED - Removes MPIN hash from user
backend_mpin_apis.MPIN validation - must be 4 digits: PASSED - Rejects empty, 3 digits, 5 digits, letters

frontend_login_page.MPIN login submits and authenticates: PASSED - Redirects to home after success
